notes.title: 1.6 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! 
A new update is out now, featuring a few [b]changes and additions to both Campaign and Ascension mode[/b] to make things a bit smoother in terms of progression!

[h1]Challenges[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 10 Challenge Battles in the Equinox Cathedral.
[/list]
[i]Challenges are a new addition in the Campaign mode.
[b]You can access the Challenge section of the Equinox Cathedral after clearing Naraka.[/b]
Here you can play a series of one-time battles of different variety and difficulty that will reward you with[b] Bones, Dark Bones and Orbs[/b]!
These battles come with their own small gimmicks and quirks, so sometimes you will have to experiment to find how to approach them the best way.
[b]A new set of challenges will unlock after defeating the final boss of Naraka, Temple of Koa and Scorched Bastion - but you can tackle them at any time![/b]
[/i]
[h1]Ascension[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased the initial number of Bones and Dark Bones at the start of every cycle after the first one.

[i]We have increased the resources you start with for Ascension cycles after the first one.
This will allow you to start with multiple passives and stat boosts, as well as items and potions, as the difficulty of Ascension gets higher.[/i]

[*]Decreased HP of several Elite Enemies

[i]A lot of Elite Enemies felt too tanky with long fights that would deplete your resources. 
We have generally decreased their HP.[/i]
[/list]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Spanish language!
[*]Added 10 new achievements
[*]Improved “Empowered” effect: after consuming a Deity level, Andora will always gain back a gem depending on the Empowered card that was played
[*]Fixed an interaction between Ishana and certain trinkets that could cause a bug
[/list]


[b]As always - we look forward to your feedback![/b]

Thank you and have fun!

[i]SH TEAM[/i]

notes.title: SHATTERED HEAVEN: OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Brave Warriors!!

It’s finally time to embark in the War of Ascension - [b]SHATTERED HEAVEN IS OUT NOW!![/b]

Today marks  the beginning of a new journey after the initial EARLY ACCESS period: [u][b]we will keep working on the game, adding new updates and features in the upcoming months, while having a solid foundation thanks to the work done during Early Access and all the feedback we received![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/11d46e1afaf08b35ab172a9f7c1adcc7340fb247.png[/img]

What you will find in the full release of Shattered Heaven:[b]
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Campaign mode[/b]
Follow the story of Andora, the Vestal of Ashram, and her guardians Magni and Ishana.
Fight through 4 different dungeons, shape your own story and reach 3 different endings and 3 unique final bosses!

[*] [b]Ascension Mode[/b]
The full roguelike game mode of Shattered Heaven!
Embark in a series of increasingly harder dungeons, face unique enemies and bosses - and restart from the beginning if you fail!
[/list]

[h1]An epic soundtrack[/h1]

[b]We’ve also released the full soundtrack of Shattered Heaven to celebrate the release![/b]

More than 4[b]0 epic tracks and 2 hours of music[/b], from epic boss themes to moody and dramatic story beats - both in mp3 and FLAC format!

[h1]A note on translations
[/h1]
Version 1.5.0 brings a new language: [b]you can now play the game in ITALIAN![/b]

[u][b]We have promised you multiple translations at release and we regret to  inform you that we are experiencing some delays. 
We will keep you updated on the progress of the other translations and release them as soon as possible!![/b][/u]

[h1]The … near future![/h1]

Today we are also happy to announce that[b] a new update will come out very soon[/b]!

A new addition to the campaign mode that was designed following your feedback is coming - stay tuned for more news very very soon!!

notes.title: SHATTERED HEAVEN'S SOUNDTRACK COMING ON NOVEMBER 8TH!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone - A quick update today as we approach the release date to finally confirm that t[b]he COMPLETE SOUNDTRACK OF SHATTERED HEAVEN will be available on release, ON NOVEMBER 8TH!
[/b]
[previewyoutube=eg2cyCOj5eA;full][/previewyoutube]
The full soundtrack features:
[list]
[*] [b]44 Epic tracks,[/b] everything you can hear ingame!
[*] [b]Over 2 Hours[/b] of music in total

[/list]

We hope you will enjoy it on your way to victory in the War of Ascension!
More news is coming soon as we get closer and closer to the release date, so stay tuned for more!

notes.title: RELEASE DATE & OCTOBER UPDATE: SECRET BOSS
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

Today we can finally announce that [b]Shattered Heaven is leaving Early Access on NOVEMEBR 8TH[/b]!
The full release will include the [b]Campaign, Ascension Mode, new languages & a few improvements and balance tweaks we will release on patch day[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/b4c103dcda4f4d30b19e1f0946e8f037500324fe.png[/img]
We will release more content and patches in the months after release - and we will continue evaluating and working on your feedback!

[h1]TODAY'S UPDATE: VERSION 1.4.0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/c7e4ad4c34c9c82eeced611adda3c0d42e5c6317.png[/img]
Today's update introduces [b]a few tweaks to Ascension Mode including a big quality of life regarding smelting cards.[/b]
But - most importantly - [b]we are introducing a new, secret boss![/b]
[i]This boss was designed as a collaboration of one of our most important supporters during our Kickstarter campaign - thank you Scott![/i]

To unlock this boss, you will need to delve deep into Ascension and unlock the advanced cycles... and find out how to unlock this new challenge yourself!

[h1]BALANCE & FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added[b] 3 free Smelt at the start of every dungeon after Naraka in Ascension Mode[/b].
[i]We realized that the amount of Neutral cards you could get in Ascension Mode could be too overwhelming. 
For this reason, everytime you enter a new dungeon after the first one (Naraka), you will be offered 3 free smelt to use as you see fit.[/i]
[*] Added Cycle 6 (Ascension)
[*] Fixed a few bugs regardings events in Ascension Mode
[*] Fixed a few typos and localization errors
[*] Fixed a bug with certain achievements not triggering in New Game +
[*] Added new Achievements tied to Ascension
[/list]

As always, we look forward to your feedback -  especially now in this last month of Early Access!
We thank you for your support during these last months and we can't wait for the full release!

notes.title: AUGUST UPDATE V 1.3: ASCENSION MODE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
ASCENSION MODE (Alpha) is out today!

This will be the first iteration of our new game mode, [u][b]and we plan to tune it regularly in the upcoming months.[/b][/u]

[h1]ASCENSION MODE & PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/39986a39ddb423eae41615fb6d07e2e0e5a8cbd6.png[/img]
ASCENSION is available immediately to everyone.
[b]We advise you to play the tutorial and try out the campaign mode first.[/b]
[i]Note: Ascension contains spoilers for the campaign mode bosses.[/i]
[list]
[*][b] Added the first 5 Cycles of Ascension[/b] - Bosses will change and new event, trinkets, relics and cards will unlock up to the 5th cycle.
[*]Added [b]old and new passives for Andora, Magni and Ishana in the Dark Forge[/b] (Ascension) Shop.
[*]Added [b]3 new BOSSES[/b] for Naraka, Temple of Koa and Scorched Bastion (Ascension).
[*]Added [b]several new ELITE encounters[/b] (Ascension).
[*]Added [b]50 RELICS[/b] to be obtained in Ascension mode.
[i]Relics are powerful items that will grant your party passives for the rest of the run![/i]
[*]All[b] Events outcomes in Ascension have been changed[/b] to better fit the Game Mode.
[*] [b]Traps have been reworked for Ascension[/b] - granting powerful bonuses if you manage to overcome them!

[list]
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs
[*]Fixed minor typos
[/list]
We look forward to hear your opinion on the new game mode!

Be sure to leave your feedback on the discussion tab or join our DISCORD!

[b]We hope you will have fun with ASCENSION![/b]

notes.title: ROGUELIKE MODE RELEASES AUGUST 21ST!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

Today we want to introduce to you all the [b]new roguelike game mode releasing on the 21st of August: [u]ASCENSION![/u][/b]

This will be the first iteration of the game mode that will be polished and improved in the upcoming months.

[h1]A ROGUELIKE EXPERIENCE[/h1]
[b]With Ascension Mode we want to focus 100% on gameplay and provide a more "Arcade" feeling[/b].
If you don't like story or you simply don't want to play the Campaign again, this is the game mode for you!

[h1]YOUR NEW MISSION[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/0753a318a0b2a85ccc59ad66b9c5ccf345dad307.png[/img]
You start Ascension in the hub, where you can set up your party and decks and immediately set out for a new challenge.
You will have to conquer 4 dungeons: explore, collect resources and face a boss at the end of each of them. 
Return back to the Ascension Hub after vanquishing the fearsome enemy and spend your hard earned resources on passives, skills equipment and more!
[b]Your adventure is over when all your party members die in combat or you manage to defeat the final boss![/b]

[h1]NEW CHALLENGES AND REWARDS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/2d7e4c143a071ea3ece11a892aadb30005d2a674.png[/img]
You will encounter [b]new, special enemies[/b] during your exploration, but also find new types of rewards.
Fearsome enemies marked with a red icon are [b]ELITE enemies[/b] - and the chests they guard might contain [b]RELICS[/b].
These powerful artifacts will give you permanent passives that will benefit the party for the rest of the run.

[h1]A NEW CYCLE BEGINS[/h1]
Upon completing Ascension, you will find yourself at the start of a new cycle.
[b]New cards will be available for your starting decks, new events and enemies will show up in the dungeons - and you will find new, powerful rewards![/b]

The [b]ALPHA VERSION of Ascension mode[/b] is coming out very soon - and we will look forward to your feedback, especially when it comes to difficulty.
[u]We will work hard to tune the encounters and challenges during these upcoming months leading to the release of the game.[/u]

[b]We'll see you on AUGUST 21st![/b]

notes.title: Shattered Heaven available NOW on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:

[h3]Greetings, Warriors![/h3]
Our latest game is finally available on Steam Early Access.

Our goal is to create an exciting experience for veterans of card games/rogue-lite games and new players alike.
With that in mind, the most important factor for us is to have plenty of feedback to work with!
The Early Access stage will be the best occasion to refine Shattered Heaven supported by our community.

Thank you for diving into Shattered Heaven's world and enjoy this unique adventure.
- Leonardo Productions

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454000/Shattered_Heaven/

[h2]What's in the Game[/h2]

Shattered Heaven is a tale of war and sin, of hope and salvation.
Guide three unlikely heroes through a washed-away world filled with bloody challenges, incredible perils, and difficult choices. But, be wary of the consequences! 
Your decisions will shape this journey into the unknown: side with unlikely allies, fight powerful foes, and witness your fate in three different Story Endings. 
[list]
[*] Play as a party of three different characters - each with their own distinct skills, cards, and playstyle.
[*] Customize their decks before setting out to explore new dungeons and unlock more character cards as the story unfolds.
[*] In pure rogue-lite tradition, Shattered Heaven's dungeons change every time you play.
[*] Blaze through four main locations, filled with unique enemies and treacherous events around every corner - let yourself be enraptured by this adrenaline-packed, everchanging adventure.
[*] After exploring new dangerous locations and completing challenging missions, rest and plan your next move at the Equinox Cathedral, the main hub of your adventures.
[*] You will be able to spend your hard-earned money at the local merchant shop to buy useful dungeon tools, materials, or equippable trinkets. 
[*] You can also craft potions by combining reagents at the alchemy shop, upgrade your abilities, and dive deeper into the story through optional dialogues. 
[*] You will be able to customize each character’s deck, equipment, and playstyle through an extensive skill tree system - the true essence of every RPG!
[/list]

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #8: lore of the tribe of Delham and Flammen
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warriors!

Today we are going to explore the remaining two tribes of the Nameless World, the[b] tribes of Delham  and Flammen[/b], and no two tribes could be more different!

[i][h3]In communion, strength. In strength, life[/h3][/i]
The forests of Delham are an intricate web of leaves, vines and bark, not unlike the body of any living being.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/aac2f19d7d3221ee85ed8b91f4fa503cc2d746b6.png[/img]

From eating the fruit of the land, to the near-cult veneration of their elders, the Delhams are a shining symbol of what greatness humanity can achieve.

These habits, however, have also raised some concerns in the mind of those who are familiar with the Porcelain Throne. 
 
The rift between Delham and the Cathedral has been growing larger with every new generation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/ef91750ed515e963eee1c1ed6ada14df791bed31.png[/img]

[i][h3]The eternal flame of Hope[/h3][/i]
Deep in the valleys among the northern mountains, the tribe of Flammen has elected to make its stand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/6cd0dd3786a5c1ac388f59f94c678d2fda85e96d.png[/img]

To the other tribes, they are brutal and efficient conquerors, who seek the complete subjugation of all those who do not consider themselves part of their Legion.

The constant stream of successes during the years had an  unforeseen consequence: many have deserted their original tribes to join the Flammen, causing their ranks to swell more and more with every passing day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/04714081b046eaed8921fbaac861f7b1bd2ee10d.png[/img]

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #7: lore of the tribe of Ashram and Sentia
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warriors!

Today we would like to explore two people far from each other, yet deeply connected.

We are talking about the [b]tribes of Ashram and Sentia[/b], and their homes.

[h3]A land of dust and thunder[/h3]

The [b]Ashram[/b] land is not what one would call a comfortable home. Here humans live among barren plains, feeding exclusively on ashes.

At its center, surrounded by scattered fossils, lies the Agonisterion. Here the Everchosen of Ashram rises to her new sacred role, and trains for the wars to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/ac1deb338495e3c154c07118f134e87168ee09f6.jpg[/img]

By the ancient motto “Every boy a Guardian, every girl a Vestal”, all children train together from a very early age. The rigorous daily exercise often leads the young warriors to form tight, everlasting bonds with their comrades in arms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/2da14057cd03ff011124ac4c3a1d40fb4ca4170e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dreams from the past[/h3]

Far to the west, hidden by high hills and built around a great chasm, stands the rocky and shining city of Cintamanya - home of the [b]Sentia[/b].

Ever loyal to their history, these people devote their lives to safeguarding the Past, singing and ever expanding their "Chant of Memory"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/011c42af1aefc15d835af08de5ae328d19b22b7e.jpg[/img]

Singing in the halls of the Chantry is not their only duty.

Their Vestal, referred to as the Chantress, holds great powers in her voice - warded by the best warriors coming from the greatest bloodlines of the Tribe, her main goal is to ensure their kin's survival. Yet, the Wheel of Fate has not been too kind on them, these past cycles...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/d13b9e718baab625fdb73360a1b69d264f857a4a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
To all the warriors out there.

After some weeks of reasonings, we've taken the tough decision to further postpone the release date of Shattered Heaven to the [b]31th of May[/b].
Our desire is to immediately offer a complete experience so that all the features that make Shattered Heaven so special will be fully appreciated. We are working hard to give to our creature the shape we've imagined since the beginning of this journey. 
In the meantime, we invite you to follow all the in-depth updates about the game coming on our shop page.
Apologies for the delay, we trust in your understanding.

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #6: A world of Ashes
notes.notes:
May the Everlasting Redeemer’s blessing be upon you, warriors!

let's take the time to delve into our World...

[h3]A nameless land, a cruel fate:
[/h3]Today, we're going to talk a bit about the story and setting of Shattered Heaven!

Every ten years, four girls - each one from a different Land - are bound to manifest incredible powers that grant them the ability to overcome incredible, inhuman feats. These maidens gain the title of holy Vestal, and they are immediately tasked with fighting - and winning - the recurrent War of the Ascension. Without a choice, they are burdened with the weight of the world.
 
Followed and protected by their Guardians, they will gather at the center of the known world, the Equinox Cathedral. Here resides the sole ruler of the land, the Divine Child [b]Heliad[/b] which looks down on all of His subjects with a serene and benevolent spirit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/e752c568da9dd29421bd0ae8803c4e5af6ebd16b.jpg[/img]

Surrounded by His servants, He is the living reincarnation of the divine that was once betrayed by humankind. Ever vigilant upon His throne, he looks down on all of His subjects with a serene and benevolent spirit. His is every Command - By His will, the four Vestals will face one perilous trials after the other, in which they will risk everything for the chance to save their people from extinction.

The Vestals are not alone in their quest for salvation. Merchants and craftspeople, sent by their tribes, populate the lower dwellings of the Cathedral, living together in an environment where the four peoples meet but never mingle, for too great is the distrust among them - a necessary evil, if they want to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/a0fbb9ca909bcb73308a81da6c19646ebb018e8f.jpg[/img]

The world of Shattered Heaven is full of untold stories, red threads of Fate, and shocking encounters. The Wheel spins, bringing forth great events and changes. 
When the time comes, where will you stand?

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #5: Powering UP
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warriors! 

It’s time for Gameplay and Mechanics!

Today we want to talk about [b]progression and power ups[/b].
It’s very important to provide a sense of constant evolution during the game, we know it - that’s why we are putting extra care in our Character Growth system.

Make sure to properly explore the [b]Equinox Cathedral[/b]  - the main hub of the game - and check out all the ways to further empower our Ashram champions!

The first one is [b]Cards[/b], of course!
Namely, we are talking about [b]Hero Cards[/b], so cards that are specific to each of our player characters - they are tailored around their mechanics and keywords, and [b]will always be available to you when you are building your decks[/b].

[b]Every time you come back to the Cathedral after a successful mission, you’ll unlock a brand-new set of powerful Hero Cards[/b] varying in skills, rarity and cost.
Don't be afraid to try different, unexpected combinations: it might hold the key to Victory!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/749/837/d29d9ab87dfed2944b5ad3eab192ba9b_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656081006&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=2383cab0c66407bca7e8cead26f6677a[/img]
 
Coming back victorious will also grant you 1 [b]Skill Point[/b] per character.

These precious resources [b]will be spent in the Talents section to grant powerful active and passive abilities[/b]. You will also be able to [b]improve your basic stats[/b] such as maximum HP and Shields.
You can also [b]save loadouts and reset skill points[/b] with no costs attached! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/749/855/6cc478919091315989269747e09015ef_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656081108&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=3b5c79bfbee81af87aba8a43e3e55e0e[/img]

And last but not least, we have the [b]Dark Forge[/b]! 

Here is where you will [b]unlock a variety of helpful perks[/b], such as improving the effectiveness of your [b]healing items, adding extra slots for rare cards[/b] in your deck and so on! 

These upgrades are extremely impressive and can only be obtained with [b]Dark Bones[/b].

This currency is strictly related to the most [b]difficult challenges [/b]you can face in the game - at the start of a dungeon you will be able to select special conditions like “Armor gained in this depth is halved”: [b]this will reward you with a higher number of Dark Bones compared to other easier challenges[/b] (or no challenges selected at all).
[b]This doesn’t mean you will never obtain Dark Bones if you plan to play the game at normal difficulty[/b] - but the more you dare, the more you will be rewarded! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/749/860/6ac07a8c987ae894b51ff01de917d24c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1656081133&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=4d3437b79faf418b0468cedb22db2d9f[/img]

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #4: Dungeon exploration
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings brave warriors![/b]

We are gonna give you a brief overview of what you are going to find when you delve deep into the dungeons of Shattered Heaven.

Be it a distant kingdom, an ancient city or the depths of the earth, you will have to face many perils and try to find the balance between greed and your own safety.

[h3][b]The Depths[/b][/h3]
Dungeons in Shattered Heaven are divided in several floors, and each of them comes with unique challenges and conditions, including optional ones that will grant you rarer loot.

For example, enemies might inflict extra debuffs on each attack, traps might be harder to avoid and so on.

Daring to face the more dangerous challenges will reward you with a greater quantity of Dark Bones, a rare currency that will grant you many useful perks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/464879bed5d3283aad2a6231b6f713647542f7b3.gif[/img]

You will also become used to draft [b]Neutral Cards[/b] after every battle.

Neutral Cards are complementary cards that you will find after battles and certain events.

In each draft you will have to assign 1 card for each character, so you will have to carefully consider your choices.

While these cards are often not as powerful as your Hero Cards, they can still work as a great tool in your arsenal: for example, one card might let you draw more cards from the deck, another a small heal to a party member or a powerful debuff, and so on!

Note that Neutral cards are not a permanent addition to your decks, but they will disappear once you leave the dungeon, making deck-building dynamic everytime you explore.

[h3][b]Events[/b][/h3]
It's not just about dangerous creatures and fights to the death!

Events are a big part of exploring a dungeon.

Simple Events usually offer both positives and negatives outcomes, often requiring you to take a leap of faith and hope for victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/b53785880d6af2e1c12f16338c0a0241163c121e.gif[/img]

Trap Events are going to deal direct damage to your characters, but you can try to avoid them or use your tools for a chance to disable them.

Arcana Events are very powerful and rare events that will grant you a sizable advantage in your explorations: being able to see what lies ahead, healing your party, even giving you power loot like trinkets! Lastly, Blasphemous Events are the most dreaded sight when you are delving deep in unexplored territories.

These twisted versions of normal events will lead you to hard and punishing choices, but even despair can turn into triumph with a bit of luck!

[h3][b]The Pyre of Vesta[/b][/h3]
It's difficult to find respite amidst chaos, but the Pyre of Vesta grants a safe haven even in the depths of this cursed world.

From refilling your potion to healing your characters, this blessed place will be your favorite stop during explorations.

And if you don't need rest, you can also get rid of unwanted cards or draft new Neutral cards while you are resting close to the Pyre, helping you make your strategies more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/592780514c4fd0c8f93ffe44733539b9781728fa.gif[/img]

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #3: Ishana's Mechanics
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave warriors!

Today we are giving you our first IN-DEPTH look at "Shattered Heaven", starting with our main cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/d0d5a46f2a068a80949adcef228064707e545482.jpg[/img]

We are going to take a closer look at Ishana's unique fighting styles and mechanics.

Let's get to it!

[b]ISHANA:[/b]

A blind outcast feared and loathed by everyone in Ashram - despite her infamous reputation, she has been chosen to accompany Andora in the War of Ascension. The mysterious, ever-hungry entity that accompanies her since she was born will surely be a powerful weapon against the enemies of the Thunderborn Vestal - proven that she won't lose control over her powers...

[b]ISHANA'S UNIQUE MECHANICS:[/b]

Ishana is able to summon her fiendish beast companion when she gains "THIRST" points from cards or by killing enemies. When the beast joins the fight, Ishana's cards will unlock new, powerful effects and will consume "THIRST" when played.

Ishana will have to carefully balance between accumulating "THIRST" and unleashing deadly attacks through her beast.

"GOUGE" is another powerful ability only she has access to; Gouged cards will be removed completely from the deck and graveyard for the duration of the fight, granting Ishana a powerful way to make her deck thinner and more consistent during a long battle.

Her beast also grants her enhanced control over negative conditions, making her especially apt at inflicting debuffs such as "BLEEDING".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/eebc1e53e4546de90c436b76f55f972d6a351f16.gif[/img]

[b]A STARTING POINT[/b]

It's important to point out that these are just the basic playstyles of our protagonists.

You will be able to craft your own unique spin on their playstyles through unlocking character cards, active and passive skills, and equipping different trinkets.

Many possibilities await you and more will come as we work to give our game more depth!

notes.title: IN-DEPTH #2: Magni's mechanics
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave warriors!

Today we are giving you our first IN-DEPTH look at "Shattered Heaven", starting with our main cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/7f01b54aaa77153d3564f250bce313fe10320aa1.jpg[/img]

We are going to take a closer look at Magni unique fighting styles and mechanics.

Let's get to it!

[b]MAGNI:[/b]
Magni is impressively strong and Andora's most devoted guardian. He has been training all his life waiting for the moment to become the guardian of the Everchosen. Duty-bound, he becomes the protector who shields his friends and smites their enemies with a poised riposte.

[b]MAGNI'S UNIQUE MECHANICS:[/b]

Magni's ability to accumulate "RAGE" by dealing and receiving damage allows him to use incredibly powerful skills during combat. With enough "RAGE" stored, Magni can unleash his powers in every turn instead of relying on cooldowns like the other characters. Magni can also take advantage of powerful synergies with Neutral Cards, like with his exclusive keyword "HALFBLOOD".

"HALFBLOOD" cards will have their cost reduced when he has 2 or more Neutral Cards in his hand.

He also has access to powerful self-buffs like "PROTECTOR" and "RIPOSTE", allowing him to protect his allies from enemy attacks and counter with deadly retaliation.

notes.notes:
Greetings, brave warriors!

Today we are giving you our first IN-DEPTH look at "Shattered Heaven", starting with our main cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/6f217d81ccdd42915b57948cf406bf8bb9f90b06.jpg[/img]

We are going to take a closer look at Andora's unique fighting styles and mechanics.

Let's get to it!

[b]ANDORA[/b]:

Andora is a fast and extremely skilled warrior. She prefers to overwhelm enemies with an endless series of fast and accurate strikes rather than relying on brute force. As the Vestal of Ashram, she is also able to wield the power of thunder.

[b]ANDORA'S UNIQUE MECHANICS[/b]:

Andora has access to the extremely powerful keyword "SWIFT" allowing her to discard cards and draw new ones and perform a series of deadly attacks in rapid succession. Some of her signature cards come with the powerful ability "SINUOUS", reducing their cost every time you discard a card.

These mighty abilities synergize extremely well with her exclusive "OVERWHELM" cards, which gain more damage for each card played during the turn.

She is also able to empower herself during battle by playing different colored cards and filling her "ASCENSION GAUGE".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42551894/a4fe7d46e0c874bf3ff40f73a64b6e2ff46b3be3.gif[/img]
